## Agent commerce (x402)
Networks: solana-mainnet-beta, eip155:8453 (Base)
Header: X-PAYMENT
Catalog: GET/POST https://www.slidphilabs.com/api/x402-products
Suite job: POST https://www.slidphilabs.com/api/x402-suite
Starter: free suite first 100 GB on /pps · then ~5¢/GB · bulk ~4¢/GB
x402_access_autoclaim: false — Stripe session verify works; agents still email proof or use /access?product= + order id.

OSS vs $199 SKUs:
blackjack / shard-zip / shard-tsdb are already-public OSS libraries.
$199 = commercial support / integration / indemnification. You do not receive a secret extra engine.

Flow: discover → list SKUs → POST buy → 402 accepts[] → pay exact USDC → retry with X-PAYMENT → order_id. Access is claimed, not auto-dumped.
